title: Alt-M stolen when doing other keyboard remapping

status.label: Retest the Alt+M conflict on current stable
status.detail: On PowerToys 0.95.1, swapping left/right Windows and Alt reportedly makes Alt+M stop working; the report says HotkeyDetective attributes it to explorer.exe only while PowerToys runs.

judgment.rationale: The reporter uses an Apple keyboard and swaps both left/right Windows and Alt keys; all other Alt/Win shortcuts work, but Alt+M fails while PowerToys runs. They report that HotkeyDetective attributes Alt+M to explorer.exe only while PowerToys is running, while the PowerToys conflict UI shows no conflict. No discussion or assignee is present, and the behavior is from 0.95.1. A current retest and confirmation of where the failure occurs are needed before concluding whether this is a PowerToys remapping conflict or a shell/app accelerator interaction.
evidence: The reporter lists PowerToys 0.95.1 on Windows 11 24H2, running as a non-admin user installation.
They swap both left/right Windows and Alt keys for an Apple keyboard; other Alt/Win shortcuts work.
Alt+M has no effect in any tested app while PowerToys is running, and works when PowerToys exits.
The reporter says HotkeyDetective shows explorer.exe using Alt+M only while PowerToys runs; the Keyboard Manager conflict window shows nothing.
There are no comments or assignees; issue search found no separate Alt-M/Explorer tracker.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the issue persists on v0.102.3001 and whether the same behavior is limited to Explorer or occurs in other applications with the same swap configuration.

fix_assessment.rationale: The behavior is reported on 0.95.1 and the Explorer hotkey interaction is not understood; current reproduction is needed before identifying a PowerToys fix path.

issue_context.summary: Swapping left/right Windows and Alt keys reportedly makes Alt+M unusable while PowerToys runs, with HotkeyDetective attributing the chord to explorer.exe.
known_information: The report lists PowerToys 0.95.1, Windows 11 24H2, and non-admin per-user installation.
Both left and right Windows/Alt keys are swapped for an Apple keyboard; other Alt and Win shortcuts work.
Alt+M fails while PowerToys runs and works when PowerToys is exited.
The reporter says HotkeyDetective identifies explorer.exe for Alt+M only while PowerToys runs; the Keyboard Manager conflict window is empty.
inferences: The shell process attribution may indicate an Explorer accelerator or a remapping interaction, but the report does not establish which process consumes the chord or why.
issue_context.analysis: Keep the reported HotkeyDetective result as evidence, not proof of an Explorer-owned global hotkey. A current test with the existing swap and an app-specific comparison is needed before designing a change.
initial_investigation: Read the issue body, labels, and assignees; there are no comments.
Searched for other PowerToys reports matching Alt-M and Explorer.exe; no separate tracker was found.

information_gaps.information: Whether Alt+M still fails on v0.102.3001 with both Windows/Alt swaps, and whether it fails in Explorer only or also in other apps
information_gaps.why_needed: The report is from 0.95.1, and the app scope determines whether this is an Explorer accelerator interaction or a general Keyboard Manager remapping regression.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: On v0.102.3001, reproduce with the same left/right Windows/Alt swaps and test Alt+M in Explorer and one other app; report the result and whether exiting PowerToys still restores it.

actions.label: Retest the Alt+M conflict on current stable

comment.body: Thanks for detailing the left/right Windows-and-Alt swaps and the HotkeyDetective result. Since the report is from PowerToys 0.95.1, could you confirm whether Alt+M still fails on v0.102.3001? Please test it in Explorer and one other app with the same swaps, and say whether exiting PowerToys still restores it.
